name: Flameshot
description: Customizable cross-platform screenshot tool with annotation and command-line support.

setup.install: Use the official stable Flameshot package or trusted distribution build and identify platform-specific screen-recording or accessibility permissions before requesting them.
setup.preserve: Flameshot configuration, saved screenshots, upload history, keyboard shortcuts, autostart entries, and existing screenshot-tool bindings
setup.safety: Do not grant screen-capture permission, capture the screen, upload images, change global shortcuts, enable autostart, or overwrite screenshots without approval.
setup.verify: Run `flameshot --version` and launch its configuration window only; confirm the application starts without taking or uploading a screenshot.

name: LocalSend
description: Private local-network file and text sharing app with no account or external server.

setup.install: Install the signed official LocalSend desktop package or trusted distribution build for the current platform and architecture.
setup.preserve: LocalSend settings, device identity, transfer history, saved files, download destination, firewall rules, and autostart preferences
setup.safety: Do not grant network or notification permissions, open firewall ports, discover devices, send or receive files, change the device name, or enable autostart without approval.
setup.verify: Launch LocalSend with discovery disabled when possible, confirm the version and download path, and stop before advertising the device or transferring data.
